selection.rule: Two official TRAIN rows from distinct source video folders; exclude video_0001 and clip ID 0001; require exact Raw inventory path and no pre-existing author MP4/receipt. Selected IDs: video_0003/0002 and video_0006/0006.
selection.author_publication_channel: CH-SIMS v2 author Google Drive Raw folder, accessed through public drive.usercontent.google.com URL; no account substitution or quota workaround.

method.stopping_rule: Stop each target immediately on quota/HTML or range/version integrity anomaly.
method.preflight: One 1-byte Range request per selected file ID, bytes=0-0, to validate public source metadata before a complete transfer.

comparison_limit: Feature index records expose the prior competition-channel media SHA for each official TRAIN ID. With author payloads blocked at preflight, no byte comparison can be made and no cohort-wide equivalence is claimed.
timestamp_note: Recorded time is the receipt/report write time after the probes; individual request start timestamps were not separately captured.

publication_redaction.reason: Exclude per-sample dataset records, long raw arrays and response/download capabilities; retain aggregate research evidence.
